title: Paper Console
summary: A warm paper theme with graphite structure, field green data, and red-pencil annotations.
descriptionMarkdown: Paper Console gives PLVS the character of a precisely printed control surface. Warm paper tones and graphite structure keep the workspace calm, field green carries primary measurements, and red-pencil accents separate secondary data and critical marks. Its olive-to-ochre-to-red level meter and natural spectrogram palette make the entire workspace feel deliberately drawn from one material system.
